newsitem.title: USA: Total Renal secondary priced at $43.25/shr.
newsitem.headline: Total Renal secondary priced at $43.25/shr.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp said Friday that it has offered 2,595,524 shares of common stock of Total Renal Care Holdings Inc at a price of $43.25 per share.

Two million of the shares being sold are being offered by affiliates of DLJ Merchant Banking Partners LP, representing their entire remaining interest in the company. The remaining shares are being sold by officers of the company.
Total Renal will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale of those shares.
Shares in the company traded at 43-1/4 Friday afternnon, down 11/16.
Total Renal Care Holdings provides integrated dialysis and renal care services for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure.
